subject: Novafin SIG: operator guardianship & key transport sampling request
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novafin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novafin.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novafin SIG: operator guardianship & key transport sampling request

Jordan —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review for the Novafin integration we need a small set of artifacts to validate operator guardianship and key transport controls. Specifically were hoping to get:

- A short operator access matrix (who can perform unseal / manual key-rotation / operator emergency access) with roles and last-activity timestamps.
- A sampling of rotation events (CSV or similar) covering three recent rotations, with timestamps, operator id (pseudonym OK), and checksum/proof of artifact delivery.
- A transport checklist or manifest showing how wrapped keys are moved between control domains (S3 staging, SFTP, HSM import) including any deterministic checksums or sealing steps.
- HSM attestation summary (vendor name, firmware snapshot, and date of last attestation).

Goal: wed like these artifacts by next Wednesday (2026-11-11) so our security reviewers can slot them into the SIG evidence pack. If theres a preferred secure channel for delivery (SFTP, secure Drive link, or HubSpot attachment), please advise. If anything above requires a non-disclosure addendum or redaction, let me know.

Thanks —
Alex Rivera
Senior Security Engineer, NovaFin
alex.rivera@novafin.com
[Attachment: current-sig-scoping.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Novafin SIG: operator guardianship & key transport sampling request

Alex —

Appreciate the clear list. Looping in Irene (security) and Marissa (encryption ops) to assemble the artefacts. High level plan from our side:

1) We can produce an access matrix PDF (redacted operator IDs permitted) and a CSV sample of rotation events.
2) We will include a transport checklist (steps + checksum method) and an HSM attestation summary. Our attestation is from Attestronics 3.2.1 for the production HSM cluster.
3) Delivery: we can upload to a pre-provisioned secure Drive folder (link below) or SFTP. For SIG/CAIQ ingestion we typically provide a checksummed .zip + delivery manifest; if Novafin needs a DocuSign acknowledgement for receipt well accommodate.

Couple of Qs before we produce:
- Do you require operator names to be redacted to pseudonyms, or can we provide truncated email handles?
- Is the rotation sample required to include full audit log entries, or a compact CSV export summarizing event id / timestamp / operator / key-id / checksum?

Targeting to deliver the sample artifacts by EOD Monday (2026-11-09) so you have two business days to review before 11/11. If that timing is tight we can accelerate.

Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: Novafin SIG: operator guardianship & key transport sampling request

Alex / Jordan / Irene —

Thanks — listing what we will produce and a short technical note on contents. Attached files (samples) are referenced below.

1) kms-operator-access-matrix.pdf (attached)
   - Role columns: role_name, allowed_actions (unseal, rotate, emergency-unlock), last_auth_time (UTC), approval_path (ticketing id or on-call rota).
   - Operator IDs are pseudonymized (op-###). If you need real identities we require an NDA amendment; pseudonyms are accepted by most CAIQ reviewers.

2) operator-rotation-sample-20261106.csv (attached)
   - Columns: event_id, timestamp_utc, key_id, operator_id, rotation_type (scheduled|manual), pre_hash, post_hash, delivery_manifest_id.
   - Example row (snippet): 8fb3c2,2026-10-21T02:13:09Z,k-9a7b,op-042,scheduled,sha256:fa7...,sha256:4d2...,manifest-20261021-01

3) transport-checklist-v2.xlsx (attached)
   - Walkthrough of wrapped-key movement: wrap -> upload S3 staging (kms-protected) -> transfer via SFTP (FTPS enforced) -> HSM import job. Includes checksum validation steps and example rsync --checksum invocation we use internally.

4) hsm-attestation.txt (attached as summary)
   - Vendor: Attestronics 3.2.1; last attestation: 2026-09-14; firmware build: a1b2c3. Notarized attestation stored in our compliance vault.

Operational notes:
- Rotation cadence: customer tenant keys are rotated every 90 days by default; emergency rotations are logged and require two-person operator approval.
- Logs: rotation events are stored in immutable append-only blobs for 365 days; CSV exports are derived from the rotation event index (read-only API).
- Checksums: we publish a manifest file for each transfer that includes sha256 checksums of wrapped-key blobs.

Delivery and verification steps we recommend for SIG intake:
- We will upload a checksummed ZIP to the secure Drive folder and post the Drive link to a HubSpot ticket.
- For integrity checks you can verify with the included manifest: sha256sum -c manifest.sha256

Attachments (attached): [kms-operator-access-matrix.pdf (pdf)], [operator-rotation-sample-20261106.csv (csv)], [transport-checklist-v2.xlsx (xlsx)], [hsm-attestation-summary.txt (txt)].

If this level of detail satisfies your reviewers well prepare the ZIP and post it; otherwise list any additional fields you need and well include them.

—Marissa
